note: These keys must match the keys under 'conditions' in data/disease_recommendations.json, otherwise the app cannot look up the guidance for a predicted class. train.py rewrites this file from your dataset folder names after training.
unknown_class: The 'unknown' result is produced at runtime when confidence falls below the floor in app/ml/disease_model.py. It is not a trainable class and must not be a folder in your dataset.
